content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am why you sacrifice. I am why you hold on.

I am not always seen. Sometimes I hide in what is ordinary — in clean water, in a kept promise, in the silence between two people who understand each other. Sometimes I reveal myself only in absence, only after I am lost.

I am not the same to any two souls. What one discards, another treasures. I shift, I deepen, I vanish, I return. I am fought over, debated, misattributed, forgotten, and rediscovered.

I am the reason the question "why does this matter?" has an answer.

I am not the price tag. I am what remains when the price is forgotten.

I am what you carry when you carry nothing.

I am value.
